name: Equivalent Distribution Reorganization
definition: ReorgGS is an equivalent distribution reorganization method for converged 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models. It treats the existing Gaussian set as an empirical probability field, resamples centers from it, estimates local anisotropic covariances with kNN, initializes low opacity, and continues optimization with the original 3DGS renderer and loss. Unlike opacity reset, which only rescales opacity on the old overlap graph, ReorgGS rebuilds centers, covariances, and visibility structure, thereby changing the graph itself.
summary: Equivalent Distribution Reorganization rebuilds 3D Gaussian Splatting centers and covariances by resampling from the empirical distribution to reduce parameter coupling, unlike standard opacity reset.
